readme: Machine-readable preview-contract ledger for issue #163. GENERATED — run
`pnpm gen:frame-coverage-ledger` after any public-API, frame or evidence change.
UNTESTED IS NOT A PASS. The absence of a demonstrated state is never evidence of support.
`covered:prop-evidence:<prop>` — every literal branch of that public prop is enumerated in
component-case-evidence.json with rendered/test evidence that resolves on disk. It proves
the visual branch matrix ONLY — never responsive, RTL, keyboard, async or AT behaviour.
`covered:declared-case:<id>` — a reviewed entry in `cases` naming a resolvable frame, a
case heading, resolvable evidence files, a reviewer and an HTTPS review link.
`not-applicable:api-manifest` — the generated TypeScript surface has no such prop; the
reason is re-derived on every CI run, so it cannot rot into a false N/A.
`not-applicable:reviewed` — a human waiver in `policy.notApplicable`, with a written reason.
Per-dimension reasons live once in `policy.dimensions`; per-export cells stay compact.

viewports.note: Issue #163 §5. An export flagged `embeddable` must additionally record every container width before `responsive` may be promoted.

dimensions.title: Controlled / uncontrolled / reset
dimensions.untestedReason: No executed case drives this export both controlled and uncontrolled and proves reset behaviour. Prop-level evidence that a `value`/`defaultValue` prop renders does NOT prove ownership semantics.
dimensions.notApplicableReason: The generated public API surface (component-api-manifest.json) exposes no controlled/uncontrolled state pair (value/defaultValue/onValueChange, checked/…, open/…, selected/…, page/…) on this export.

dimensions.title: Disabled / read-only / loading / empty / error / success
dimensions.untestedReason: No executed case walks this export through its disabled, read-only, loading, empty, error and success states.
dimensions.notApplicableReason: The generated public API surface (component-api-manifest.json) exposes no disabled/readOnly/loading/invalid/required/error/success/empty state prop on this export.

dimensions.title: Async: loading / reject / retry / cancel / offline
dimensions.untestedReason: No executed case exercises the async lifecycle (loading, reject, retry, cancel, stale/background refresh, offline). Per docs/FRAME-COVERAGE.md a blanket primitive-default not-applicable is FORBIDDEN — every export must eventually be classified explicitly.

dimensions.title: Responsive viewport matrix
dimensions.untestedReason: No executed case records this export rendering correctly across the required 320/375/390/768/1024/1280/1440/1920 matrix. The frame-geometry sweep proves only the absence of horizontal overflow and clipped controls on the frames it swept; it is not a responsive-layout case.

dimensions.title: RTL / direction
dimensions.untestedReason: No executed RTL case exists for this export. `?dir=rtl` being available on every /frame route makes RTL EXERCISABLE; it does not make it exercised.

dimensions.title: Long / localized content stress
dimensions.untestedReason: No executed case stresses this export with long Japanese/Vietnamese strings, large numbers, or missing/invalid data.

dimensions.title: Keyboard / focus order / focus return
dimensions.untestedReason: No executed case asserts keyboard traversal, focus order and focus restoration for this export.

dimensions.title: Accessible name / description / error association
dimensions.untestedReason: No executed case asserts the COMPUTED accessible name, description and error association for this export. An axe pass is a rule scan, not a naming contract.

dimensions.title: Preferences: reduced motion / forced colors / 200% zoom / coarse touch
dimensions.untestedReason: No executed case renders this export under prefers-reduced-motion, forced-colors, 200% zoom or a coarse pointer.

geometry.note: Recorded frame×width overflow / clipped-control failures from the shrink-only geometry baseline. NOT re-executed by this generator — the sweep needs Chromium plus a built preview. It proves the absence of overflow on the frames it swept; it is not a responsive-layout case and never promotes `responsive`.

axe.note: Recorded per-frame axe violations from the shrink-only axe baseline. NOT re-executed by this generator. An axe pass never promotes `accessibleName` or `keyboard`.

infra.note: Global harness capabilities this branch provides for EVERY /frame/** route — they make a dimension EXERCISABLE, but a per-component `covered` mark still requires an authored case that demonstrates it.
infra.rtl: ?dir=rtl on any /frame/<id> flips logical CSS for the whole subtree
infra.accessibilityAxe: scripts/check-frame-axe.mjs (check:frame-axe) — desktop + mobile-sm axe per frame

baseline.note: Ratchet floor. `covered` may only rise, `knownMissingFrames` / sweep failures may only shrink. The large pre-existing `untested` backlog is RECORDED here, not passed off as coverage — it is the honest state of issue #163 and it is what the epic has to burn down.
